summary: Five churches in one family of parishes. Weekend and daily Masses agree in all five bulletins; both 24-hour Adoration chapels are recorded daily, plus first-Friday Adoration at Ss. Peter and Paul and the three Nov 2 All Souls Masses. Open: the Nativity first-Friday church Adoration and a website-only Saturday Confession at St. Bernadette.
